headline: Indian Markets Open Cautiously After Thursday's Crash; Property Stocks and IPOs in Focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Elevated crude oil prices surging above $100 per barrel weighing on market sentiment
Rising bond yields and a stronger US dollar impacting global equity markets
Recovery attempt following a sharp 1,200-point Sensex crash in the previous session
Bullish outlook from Jefferies on property stocks citing strong launch momentum
whatHappening: Nifty and Sensex opened flat to slightly positive after falling below key support levels on Thursday
Multiple IPOs including Moneyview and Adroit Industries are seeing high subscription levels and GMP gains
Axiom Gas Engineering SME IPO is scheduled to list on the exchanges today
JSW One Platforms has filed a DRHP with SEBI to raise up to Rs 3,054 crore via IPO
summary: Indian markets are attempting to stabilize after a major sell-off on Thursday driven by high oil prices and surging yields. While the broader market remains cautious, property stocks are seeing interest following positive brokerage reviews. The IPO segment continues to show strength with several companies reporting high subscription rates and new filings.
